description: Block for up to `timeout` seconds (max 30) until a new inbox item arrives, then return it exactly like askew_inbox_list. Use this in a loop to react to the phone in near real time (e.g. answer a shared article, log a payment). Returns 'inbox empty' on timeout without error, so simply call it again. Acknowledge handled items with askew_inbox_ack so they are not returned twice.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only items created after this moment count. Default: any unacknowledged item.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a new item, 1–30 (default 30). Returns early as soon as an item arrives; returns 'inbox empty' on timeout.

name: askew_inbox_wait
